posting.text:
Nvidia's board let Jensen Huang resign over a concealed relationship, and it cost more than his salary. The hard way: founders think loyalty buys leeway. It doesn't. Governance is a product feature. Next time, build independent oversight before the scandal.
#BigTech #Cloud

bestPost.text:
Anthropic 发布 Sonnet 5.5，大家盯跑分，我盯默认值：模型越强，迁移成本越高，你的工作流被锁得越死， 模型是别人的，流程才是你的，默认用它之前，把回滚路径写成三行脚本，把成本折算成 API 单价，把切换窗口标进日历， 谁掌握默认，谁掌握你的利润。
#AI #DevTools
